patches.name: U1_swa_sdpa_mask_memoize
patches.description: Memoize the SDPA sliding-window mask in SWA3DRoPEAttention (eliminates mask recomputation per block and diffusion step)

patches.name: U2_sampler_schedule_host_syncs
patches.description: Remove per-step host syncs from EDM sampler schedule (converts schedule/gammas to floats once instead of 3 item() syncs/step)

patches.name: U3_confidence_chain_pair_host_syncs
patches.description: Drop redundant per-chain host sync in ConfidenceHead pair_chains_iptm

patches.name: U4_trimul_stage3_row_pitch_alignment
patches.description: Stage-3 einsum operand alignment to multiple of 8 for fast cuBLAS kernel on non-multiple-of-8 token lengths

patches.name: U5_pair_bias_int64_offsets
patches.description: 64-bit row offsets in fused pair-bias kernel (prevents negative offset wrapping / out of bounds access on long sequences)

patches.name: U6_msa_features_vectorised
patches.description: Vectorise msa_to_res_type_and_deletions over whole byte buffer instead of per-character Python loop
